title: People Magazine Investigates: The University of Cosmic Intelligence Cult
description: Rashad Jamal rises online as a self-proclaimed prophet, creating a cult that mixes cosmic teachings with conspiracy.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective

S01 E01 — Fourteen Stories Down

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S01 E02 — Murder, Murder, Murder

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S01 E03 — Hazard Lights
The abduction and murder of a beloved young schoolteacher shakes a sleepy New England town to its core. Veteran investigator Robert Cushing is called in to lead the manhunt, but even he is caught off guard by the depravity of the killer's plan.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S07 E11 — He Won't Tell Us Why
Richard and Ryan Girgis knew their father, Magdi, was not a particularly good father, but when their family is torn apart, the brothers feel they had known he was evil all along.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S09 E06 — The Box on Her Doorstep
Teenager Sarah Garone is targeted by an anonymous predator for nearly a decade; each time, Sarah turns to her stepfather, Gary Hardy, for protection, not realizing he is the one determined to hurt her.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S07 E08 — I Should Have Killed Him Myself
John Duck spends his entire life fearing the day his brother Kevin would finally kill someone, but when John discovers his brother is actually a murderer, he still isn't ready to face that Kevin had been born a killer.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S07 E01 — It Was All Judith
As a child, Corey Breininger's stepmother, Judith Hawkey, coerces him into doing something horrible; he keeps her deadly secret for years, too afraid to tell anyone the truth.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S07 E12 — The Werewolf Butcher
Jack Roy Spillman starts collecting wolf memorabilia, and his sisters think it's an odd hobby; when they learn of horrific things he's done, they realize some people may have been right when they called him more animal than human.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S07 E02 — I Raised a Sociopath
Robert Foust contemplates killing his son, Aaron, as the only way to prevent Aaron from becoming a murderer; instead, Robert chooses to put himself and his son in God's hands, and God's plan makes him question everything.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S18 E02 — My Love Put a Gun to My Head
When Dreamer meets Teddy, she sees a broken young man and hopes her love will change him; he returns her love with fear, cruelty and control; after her father tries to help her escape his clutches, Teddy makes them pay a price.

title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
description:
S01 E05 — The Child I Thought I Knew
A single mother overcoming addiction struggles to raise her son and daughter; despite what appears to be a loving family and a sibling bond she could only hope for, she never could have foreseen the true monster that lies within her 13-year-old son.

title: A Body in the Basement
description:
S03 E06 — Conditional Love
Days after New Year, the close-knit Baychester community in the Bronx is stunned by the sudden disappearance of a beloved local daycare owner. Investigators soon grapple with a shocking twist in the story right under their noses.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:

description:

description:

An entrepreneur is fatally gunned down in his warehouse, leading detectives to examine his disgruntled employees and his mistress in search of the killer.

Firefighter William Walker and his new wife, Uloma, live in a tight-knit Cleveland neighborhood, when he is gunned down in their driveway, turning everyone in his life into a suspect.

Rob and Brenda Andrew, a devout couple living in the Bible Belt of Oklahoma City, find their world shattered when both of them are shot during a violent home invasion; the mastermind proves to be closer than anyone imagined.

A rash of break-ins shatters the peace in a tight-knit community; when residents take sides, good friends turn into deadly enemies.

A U.S. Army veteran goes out of his way to make his neighbors feel welcome; when a child's birthday gift goes missing, it takes only 37 days for the friendships to end in a killing spree.

description:
S08 E02 — Sergeant Hassel
Officers find Tyrone Hassel III shot to death outside his father's home while on holiday leave from the Army; investigators must unravel a real whodunit, and when the killer finally comes out, the detectives can't hide their shock.

title: The Murder Tapes
description:
S08 E05 — Club Chaos
Lima, Ohio police race to a chaotic scene at an after-hours nightclub following a shooting that leaves one person dead and multiple others injured; as they try to identify the shooter, dozens of patrons flee in fear, confusing first responders.

title: The Murder Tapes
description:
S08 E04 — I Did Something Real Bad
Police find Orlando Euell's body left for dead on the side of the road in Milwaukee; police examine extensive surveillance footage to learn about Orlando's last moments, including witnessing him get into the car that would take him to his death.

title: The Murder Tapes
description:
S07 E03 — One in the Chamber
A retirement community in Evansville, Ind., reels when police find Odie Carrier Jr. mortally shot in his own home; puzzled even more by the surprising way he died, police must work quickly if they are going to find the person responsible.

title: The Murder Tapes
description:
S08 E06 — Help, I've Been Shot
Officers with the Evansville police department arrive at a crime scene to find a shooting victim barely alive and needing medical attention; the stakes get higher after they realize there might be another injured victim who's now missing.

title: The Murder Tapes
description:
S07 E02 — Friends Like These
A woman shocks the Titus County Sheriff's Office when she reports the kidnapping of her husband, Ernie; police race to find him, but things are not as they seem, and they must first figure out who is telling the truth to them to solve the case.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S04 E08 — The Barrel
In the Miami suburbs, a hard-working mother from Trinidad vanishes into thin air; detectives Danny Smith and Jonathan Zeller soon uncover her secrets but then are stalled until they come up with a highly unusual way to smoke out the perpetrator.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S04 E07 — Six Pounds of Pressure
A mother raises the alarm when her daughter goes missing from the Colorado house she had recently moved into; while Det. Ben Endreson is investigating, an unusual suspect comes forward to confess her involvement, but her story doesn't quite add up.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S04 E03 — Crimson Snow
Police find an accomplished U.S. Forest Service worker executed beneath a mound of snow in Northern California; a missing wallet and a pair of jumper cables send Investigator Greg Hagwood on a multi-state manhunt for the killer.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S04 E02 — Mr. Innocent
In Minnesota, firemen put out a house fire and find a woman's body inside; Agent Rob Frank learns that the victim was babysitting a friend's daughter, who is now missing; it is a race against time to track down the killer with a horrifying motive.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S04 E01 — It Begins With One
When a young woman turns up dead in south Texas, Captain Federico Calderon fears the killer has disappeared into Mexico; as more bodies turn up, investigators pick up on the trail of a serial killer, leading to a showdown in the streets of Laredo.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
It Begins With One
Detectives close in on a suspect as the investigation intensifies; they must stop the killer before he strikes again.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:

After a father is found shot in front of his home, Kenda uncovers a vengeful motive behind a deadly family feud; a church turns into a house of horrors as officers face a life-or-death decision when confronted by a knife-wielding psychopath.

title: A Body in the Basement
description:
S03 E07 — Living Through Hell
Nino Puglisi's shooting death leaves his wife, Debbie, missing; initially seen as domestic violence, a puddle of blood in the basement and a terrifying 911 call reveal the horrifying details behind Nino's murder and what exactly happened to Debbie.

title: A Body in the Basement
description:
S03 E08 — She Said No
In the dead of winter, a killer murders a young mother next to her sleeping daughters, shocking a quiet Pennsylvania community; but investigators confronting mysterious clues at the scene soon learn that the killer is several steps ahead of them.
